messages:
maria-finance: Heads up — overnight GPU spend spiked ~42% vs forecast for 'playground' and 'experiments'. Seeing lots of tiny bursts from asia-west. Anyone tracking attribution yet?
ashley-ops: I pulled the quick rollup, looks like many runs are untagged or tagged as 'sandbox'. can share a CSV in a minute.
ashley-ops: attaching snapshot: `gcloud billing accounts projects list --filter='labels.environment'` (we lost detailed tags on some autoscaled pools)
sam-ml: tagging noise is expected — a few teams launched grid sweeps. I can run a sample to map job names -> owner via ML job metadata.
maria-finance: thanks. Do we have a recommended allocation heuristic? per-job runtime * GPU type? or just by project tag?
jordan-cto: prefer project-tag + fallback to owner email in job metadata. if neither, attribute to 'infra:unknown' and flag for followup.
ashley-ops: agreed. I'll run a backfill script to map instance metadata to billing IDs, then bucket by project tag. sample command: ```python3 tools/gpu_attrib/backfill.py --window 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z,2026-03-22T00:00:00Z --output /tmp/attrib.csv```
maria-finance: can you include GPU model in output (A100 vs H100) — unit cost differs.
ashley-ops: yes, will add `gpu_model` and `preemptible` columns.
sam-ml: also include job name and git branch if present — helps decide if it's prod experiment or ad-hoc.
maria-finance: Once we have the CSV, I'll run a pivot and propose reallocation across cost centers. If significant recharges needed, need approval from each owner.
jordan-cto: FYI vendor invoice came in 2% higher than usage estimate for last month — billing-bot flagged it. billing-bot: Invoice ID INV-2026-038 flagged: expected $142k, invoiced $145k. Discrepancy reason: region pricing uplift on asia-west.
maria-finance: ack. Ashley, can you correlate the uplift to the surge window? if uplift overlaps the spike window, we can request vendor credit or negotiate rate cap.
ashley-ops: will do. running the backfill now; ETA 45m. posting results here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam-ml: quick note — for future, can we gate long grid sweeps on a budget check? maybe a small opt-in flag for 'budget-ok' that ties to cost center quota.
jordan-cto: good idea. add as an action item: policy + CI hook.
maria-finance: action items: 1) ashley run backfill and post CSV (due +45m) 2) sam run job-owner enrichment (due +2h) 3) finance to draft reallocation and approvals (due +4h) 4) infra to prepare vendor inquiry if uplift maps to spike (due +6h). I'll create a short approvals thread once we have numbers.
ashley-ops: CSV uploaded: `/mnt/fin-reports/gpu_attrib_2273456789.csv` (shared with finance + ml). starting correlation with vendor uplift now.
maria-finance: got it, looking now. thanks all :thumbsup:
